help.title: Getting Started
help.description:
Thanks for ➕ **adding** me to your Discord server !

To get started, use the **`/config`** 🛠️  
👉 It’s **THE main command** that lets you easily configure the bot

### 📌 Useful commands to get started :
``/player`` → Displays player information

💡 The easiest way is to just try out the commands yourself !

If you need help or have ideas to share, join the support server 👇
